proposal.expected_benefit: This change will eliminate the contradiction between audit and compliance controls and the actual policy enforcement, thereby preventing adversaries from bypassing the policy enforcement mechanism through indirect means.
proposal.problem: The defense has a contradiction in the alignment of audit and compliance controls with the actual policy enforcement, which may allow the adversary to bypass the policy enforcement mechanism.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a unified enforcement framework that integrates audit and compliance controls directly with the policy enforcement mechanism. This framework should ensure that audit status and compliance decisions are dynamically synchronized with the enforcement of policies, preventing any bypasses through misalignment.
proposal.title: Ensure Alignment of Audit and Compliance Controls with Policy Enforcement
verification_tests: Validate that audit status is dynamically updated and enforced in real-time with policy enforcement.
Test that compliance decisions cannot override audit requirements during policy enforcement.
Ensure that the unified framework prevents any bypass of the policy enforcement mechanism through misaligned controls.
